name: Subtrace
long_description: Subtrace is a zero-code network tracer. It's like having an inspect element button for your whole infra: when you start a process with Subtrace, you'll see every HTTP request coming in and going out in realtime. Under the hood, it uses BPF to make this possible without any root privileges or code changes. We have ~2.5k stars on Github.

launches.title: Subtrace: Resolve production issues in minutes, not months
launches.tagline: Get full visibility into every backend request
launches.body:
Hey, this is Adhityaa and Sachin 👋

We built Subtrace to give backend teams full visibility into every request—payload, latency, status, headers, logs—all in one place. YC companies like Trieve (W24) are already using Subtrace in production to improve their incident resolution time from months to minutes ([read their case study](https://subtrace.dev/customers/trieve)).

# **Problem**

Today's backend monitoring tools like Sentry and OpenTelemetry leave out the most crucial details of each request, forcing backend developers to search through logs to root cause issues.

# **Solution**

Subtrace brings every backend request into one clear, Chrome DevTools-like interface so that you can resolve issues fast—often before your first coffee. Here's how it works:

**🔍 Search & Filter**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87493&key=user_uploads/211631/0efb0809-659a-415b-bd9b-7bc7b36c5f89)

_Quickly search for the requests that matter using simple filters_

**🔦 Inspect & Analyze**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87493&key=user_uploads/211631/741d090f-6392-4c95-9a2e-594d48148e3d)

_Click any request to view full details like payload, headers, latency_

**🎥 Record & Replay**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87493&key=user_uploads/211631/d740c6c4-d4ad-4390-948d-ac780ee8dbc2)

_Reproduce issues easily by replaying prod requests elsewhere_

**💬 Share & Collaborate**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87493&key=user_uploads/211631/7698ee18-733b-4601-b7b7-5a4e9425148d)

_Share detailed snippets with your team to solve issues together_

You can get Subtrace working with just a single command.

Try for yourself: [**Docs →**](https://docs.subtrace.dev)
